# arin_rdap_entities (Data Source)

Search public RDAP entities by handle or name, including organizations, POCs and customer entities returned by ARIN. Supports one trailing wildcard. No API key is sent. Results use ARIN search semantics and are sorted by handle; partial results, duplicates and referrals are rejected. A structured RDAP no-match response produces an empty list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by go generate.
data "arin_rdap_entities" "example" {
  search_by = "handle"
  query     = "EXAMPLE-*"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `query` (String) Exact search term or a term ending in one wildcard (*). Name matching is performed by ARIN, including its name-component matching rules.
- `search_by` (String) Search field: handle or name (mapped to RDAP fn).

### Read-Only

- `entities` (Attributes List) Entity records returned by ARIN, ordered by handle. No matches, including a structured RDAP 404, produce an empty list. Other failures remain errors. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entities))

<a id="nestedatt--entities"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entities`

Read-Only:

- `address_labels` (List of String) address labels returned by ARIN.
- `emails` (List of String) emails returned by ARIN.
- `entities` (Attributes List) entities returned by ARIN. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entities--entities))
- `events` (Attributes List) events returned by ARIN. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entities--events))
- `handle` (String) handle returned by ARIN.
- `kind` (String) kind returned by ARIN.
- `names` (List of String) Formatted names from jCard fn properties, sorted and deduplicated.
- `phones` (List of String) Telephone values as returned, including tel: URIs when used by ARIN. Parameters remain in vcard_json.
- `rdap_json` (String) Complete RDAP entity JSON, including nested entities, links, notices, remarks and extensions. Links are not followed.
- `roles` (List of String) roles returned by ARIN.
- `status` (List of String) status returned by ARIN.
- `vcard_json` (String) Complete jCard JSON, preserving structured addresses, parameters, repeated properties and extensions. Null when omitted.

<a id="nestedatt--entities--entities"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entities.entities`

Read-Only:

- `handle` (String) handle returned by ARIN.
- `roles` (List of String) roles returned by ARIN.


<a id="nestedatt--entities--events"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entities.events`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) action returned by ARIN.
- `date` (String) date returned by ARIN.
